People, tell me if this is normal.  I went to my wife's stylist for a men's cut.  I made an appointment and showed up like 5-10 minutes early.  She recognized me and told me she'd be right with me even though she had a woman in the chair.  30 minutes later she called me back.  No biggie, right?  Anyway, while in the chair, another woman walked in and took a seat just outside the door like I had done when I arrived.  She began rushing through the cut and even left out some to the little things she had done the last time like trimming my eyebrows and inside my ears.  You know, little details.  What made me frustrated was that she charged me full price.  Now I realize she wanted to move on to the woman behind me because that cut/style was much more than mine was ($$$).  is this normal practice - rushing through an appointment and doing an incomplete job just to chase the money?

When i went home and talked to my wife about it, she just brushed it off like she understood why her stylist did it.  Now, something minor happened once to my wife by the same stylist and to my wife, it was monumental.
